info.title: Checkout
info.description: Checkout support a buyer's shopping journey, enabling them to receive and purchase products through personalized payment agreement options

get.description:
Allows a consumer to list all Applications within their user scope (e.g. Tenants, Buyers and Merchants can only retrieve their own Applications). By providing query parameters, the list results can be filtered.

Upon success, a paginated list of relevant Applications will be returned. If no Applications were found with the provided filters, the response will be 200 OK with an empty array of Applications.

**JWT Claim Authorization:**
**TenantID**: Required (non-nil); scopes results to the caller's tenant.
**MerchantID**: Optional; if present in token and a `merchantID` query filter is also provided, they must match or the request is rejected. If present in token, applied as a filter.
**ProgramID**: Optional; if present in token, applied as a filter.
**BuyerID**: Optional; if present in token, limits results to the caller's own applications.

parameters.name: buyerID.eq
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the Buyer.

parameters.name: merchantID.eq
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the Merchant. Must match merchantID on the JWT if provided.

parameters.name: status.eq
parameters.description: The status to filter the Application records by.

parameters.name: statusCode.eq
parameters.description: The status code to filter the Application records by.

parameters.name: statusCode.ne
parameters.description: The status code that don't match to filter the Application records by.

parameters.name: showExpired.eq
parameters.description: Show expired applications. Defaults to true.

parameters.name: normalizedAddressHash.eq
parameters.description: Show applications associated with provided normalized address hash.

parameters.name: metadata.eq
parameters.description: Show metadata associated with the application. Defaults to false.

parameters.name: updatedAt.gte
parameters.description: The lower bound of the date range, inclusive.

parameters.name: updatedAt.lte
parameters.description: The upper bound of the date range, inclusive.

parameters.name: lastTimestamp.eq
parameters.description: The timestamp value formatted per RFC3339 of the last Application from the previous page, used for keyset pagination. Depends on whether createdAt or updatedAt is used for sorting.

parameters.name: lastID.eq
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the last ID from the previous page, used for keyset pagination.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Specifies the sort order for paginated results. Accepts createdAt or updatedAt fields with ascending or descending order.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: The maximum number of records that will be returned in a result set.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: The number of records to skip before starting to collect the result set. Used in conjunction with limit query parameter for pagination support

200.description: The list of Applications including pagination.

applications.description: The list of Applications that satisfy the provided filtering and scope conditions.

schema.title: ApplicationError
schema.description: Default error model for application errors

message.description: A simple message in english describing the error and can be returned to the consumer

domain.description: The domain where the error is originating from as defined by the service

metadata.description: Any additional details to be conveyed as determined by the service. If present, will return map of key value pairs

reason.description:
A machine-readable reason code identifying the specific error condition. Possible values and their meanings:

- `Application_Not_Found`: No Application exists for the provided ID within the caller's scope.
- `Short_Code_Not_Found`: No in-store short code exists matching the provided value.
- `Tenant_Not_Found`: The Tenant ID derived from the JWT could not be found.
- `Buyer_Not_Found`: The Buyer ID derived from the JWT or request could not be found.
- `Location_Not_Found`: The Location ID provided in the request extensions could not be found.
- `Merchant_Not_Found`: The Merchant ID derived from the JWT or request could not be found.
- `Payment_Agreement_Not_Found`: No Payment Agreement exists for the provided Agreement ID.
- `Offer_Not_Found`: No Offer exists for the provided Offer ID.
- `Start_Request_Validation`: One or more fields in the Start Application request failed validation. Check the `metadata` field for per-field details.
- `Checkout_Request_Validation`: One or more fields in the Checkout request failed validation. Check the `metadata` field for per-field details.
- `Prescreen_Request_Validation`: One or more fields in the Prescreen request failed validation.
- `Eligibility_Request_Validation`: One or more fields in the Eligibility request failed validation.
- `List_Request_Validation`: One or more query parameters in the List Applications request failed validation.
- `Request_Validation`: One or more fields in the request failed validation.
- `Invalid_Request_Body`: The request body could not be parsed as valid JSON.
- `Too_Many_Requests`: The request was rejected due to rate limiting. Retry after a short back-off period.
- `Missing_Required_IDs`: The JWT is missing required identity claims (e.g. tenantID).
- `Disclosure_Invalid`: One or more disclosures failed validation (e.g. invalid checksum or missing required type).
- `Invalid_Application_Status`: The Application is not in a status that permits the requested operation.
- `Invalid_Offer_Status`: The Offer is not in a status that permits the requested operation.
- `ApplicationExpired`: The Application has passed its expiration time and can no longer be used.
- `Short_Code_Expired`: The in-store short code associated with the Application has expired.
- `Application_Not_Expired`: A request was made that requires the Application to be expired, but it has not expired yet.
- `Down_Payment_Failure`: The down-payment payment method authorization failed during Checkout.
- `Down_Payments_Not_Enabled`: Down payments are not enabled for this Program or Merchant-Program configuration.
- `Payment_Method_Not_Found`: No Payment Method exists for the provided Payment Method ID.
- `Failed_Transaction_Auth_Check`: The transaction authorization check against the buyer's account failed.
- `Purchase_Window_Closed`: The HyLOC purchase window has been closed; the transaction cannot be authorized.
- `Purchase_Window_Closed_Prior_To_Request`: The HyLOC purchase window was already closed before this request was received.
- `Expected_Purchase_Window_Close_Date_Not_Set`: The expected purchase-window close date was not set before a subsequent transaction authorization was attempted.
- `Invalid_Payment_Product`: The Payment Product associated with the Application is not valid for the requested operation.
- `Insufficient_Remaining_Capacity`: The transaction amount exceeds the Application's remaining capacity.
- `Invalid_Program_Checkout_Mode`: The Program's configured checkout mode does not match the type of checkout being attempted.
- `Merchant_Is_Not_Bopis_Enabled`: The Merchant is not configured for Buy Online, Pickup In-Store (BOPIS) checkout.
- `Resource_Forbidden`: The JWT does not have sufficient privileges to perform this action on the requested resource.
- `Dependency_Response_Invalid`: A required downstream service returned a response that could not be processed.
- `Dependency_Response_Error`: A required downstream service returned an unrecoverable error.
- `Dependency_Unavailable`: A required downstream service did not respond or is unavailable.
- `Service_Unavailable`: The Application service is temporarily unable to process the request.

- `Down_Payment_Failure`: The down-payment payment method authorization failed during Checkout.
- `Down_Payments_Not_Enabled`: Down payments are not enabled for this Program or Merchant-Program configuration.
- `Payment_Method_Not_Found`: No Payment Method exists for the provided Payment Method ID.
- `Failed_Transaction_Auth_Check`: The transaction authorization check against the buyer's account failed.
- `Purchase_Window_Closed`: The HyLOC purchase window has been closed; the transaction cannot be authorized.
- `Purchase_Window_Closed_Prior_To_Request`: The HyLOC purchase window was already closed before this request was received.
- `Expected_Purchase_Window_Close_Date_Not_Set`: The expected purchase-window close date was not set before a subsequent transaction authorization was attempted.
- `Invalid_Payment_Product`: The Payment Product associated with the Application is not valid for the requested operation.
- `Insufficient_Remaining_Capacity`: The transaction amount exceeds the Application's remaining capacity.
- `Invalid_Program_Checkout_Mode`: The Program's configured checkout mode does not match the type of checkout being attempted.
- `Merchant_Is_Not_Bopis_Enabled`: The Merchant is not configured for Buy Online, Pickup In-Store (BOPIS) checkout.
- `Resource_Forbidden`: The JWT does not have sufficient privileges to perform this action on the requested resource.
- `Dependency_Response_Invalid`: A required downstream service returned a response that could not be processed.
- `Dependency_Response_Error`: A required downstream service returned an unrecoverable error.
- `Dependency_Unavailable`: A required downstream service did not respond or is unavailable.
- `Service_Unavailable`: The Application service is temporarily unable to process the request.

post.description:
Allows a Buyer to create an Application.

Upon success, the details of the created Application will be returned. Possible Application statuses include INELIGIBLE, NEEDS_ACTION, DENIED and APPROVED. Any of these statuses will result in a 201 Created response - the client must check the status field in the response body.

Approved Applications will have one or more Payment Agreements that can be presented to the Buyer to Checkout.

For instore applications, a locationID key-value pair must be present as an extension.

**JWT Claim Authorization:**
**TenantID**: Required (non-nil); set as the application's `tenantID`.
**MerchantID**: Optional; resolved from token or request body and set as the application's `merchantID`.
**ProgramID**: Optional; resolved from token or request body and set as the application's `programID`.
**BuyerID**: Optional; set as the application's `buyerID`.

schema.title: ApplicationError
schema.description: Default error model for application errors

message.description: A simple message in english describing the error and can be returned to the consumer

domain.description: The domain where the error is originating from as defined by the service

metadata.description: Any additional details to be conveyed as determined by the service. If present, will return map of key value pairs

reason.description:
A machine-readable reason code identifying the specific error condition. Possible values and their meanings:

- `Application_Not_Found`: No Application exists for the provided ID within the caller's scope.
- `Short_Code_Not_Found`: No in-store short code exists matching the provided value.
- `Tenant_Not_Found`: The Tenant ID derived from the JWT could not be found.
- `Buyer_Not_Found`: The Buyer ID derived from the JWT or request could not be found.
- `Location_Not_Found`: The Location ID provided in the request extensions could not be found.
- `Merchant_Not_Found`: The Merchant ID derived from the JWT or request could not be found.
- `Payment_Agreement_Not_Found`: No Payment Agreement exists for the provided Agreement ID.
- `Offer_Not_Found`: No Offer exists for the provided Offer ID.
- `Start_Request_Validation`: One or more fields in the Start Application request failed validation. Check the `metadata` field for per-field details.
- `Checkout_Request_Validation`: One or more fields in the Checkout request failed validation. Check the `metadata` field for per-field details.
- `Prescreen_Request_Validation`: One or more fields in the Prescreen request failed validation.
- `Eligibility_Request_Validation`: One or more fields in the Eligibility request failed validation.
- `List_Request_Validation`: One or more query parameters in the List Applications request failed validation.
- `Request_Validation`: One or more fields in the request failed validation.
- `Invalid_Request_Body`: The request body could not be parsed as valid JSON.
- `Too_Many_Requests`: The request was rejected due to rate limiting. Retry after a short back-off period.
- `Missing_Required_IDs`: The JWT is missing required identity claims (e.g. tenantID).
- `Disclosure_Invalid`: One or more disclosures failed validation (e.g. invalid checksum or missing required type).
- `Invalid_Application_Status`: The Application is not in a status that permits the requested operation.
- `Invalid_Offer_Status`: The Offer is not in a status that permits the requested operation.
- `ApplicationExpired`: The Application has passed its expiration time and can no longer be used.
- `Short_Code_Expired`: The in-store short code associated with the Application has expired.
- `Application_Not_Expired`: A request was made that requires the Application to be expired, but it has not expired yet.
- `Down_Payment_Failure`: The down-payment payment method authorization failed during Checkout.
- `Down_Payments_Not_Enabled`: Down payments are not enabled for this Program or Merchant-Program configuration.
- `Payment_Method_Not_Found`: No Payment Method exists for the provided Payment Method ID.
- `Failed_Transaction_Auth_Check`: The transaction authorization check against the buyer's account failed.
- `Purchase_Window_Closed`: The HyLOC purchase window has been closed; the transaction cannot be authorized.
- `Purchase_Window_Closed_Prior_To_Request`: The HyLOC purchase window was already closed before this request was received.
- `Expected_Purchase_Window_Close_Date_Not_Set`: The expected purchase-window close date was not set before a subsequent transaction authorization was attempted.
- `Invalid_Payment_Product`: The Payment Product associated with the Application is not valid for the requested operation.
- `Insufficient_Remaining_Capacity`: The transaction amount exceeds the Application's remaining capacity.
- `Invalid_Program_Checkout_Mode`: The Program's configured checkout mode does not match the type of checkout being attempted.
- `Merchant_Is_Not_Bopis_Enabled`: The Merchant is not configured for Buy Online, Pickup In-Store (BOPIS) checkout.
- `Resource_Forbidden`: The JWT does not have sufficient privileges to perform this action on the requested resource.
- `Dependency_Response_Invalid`: A required downstream service returned a response that could not be processed.
- `Dependency_Response_Error`: A required downstream service returned an unrecoverable error.
- `Dependency_Unavailable`: A required downstream service did not respond or is unavailable.
- `Service_Unavailable`: The Application service is temporarily unable to process the request.

get.description:
Allows a consumer to retrieve an Application by supplying an Application ID.

Upon success, the Application details will be returned. Access is limited by user scope (e.g. Tenants, Buyers and Merchants can only retrieve their own Applications).

**JWT Claim Authorization:**
**TenantID**: Required (non-nil); cross-tenant access is not permitted.
**MerchantID**: Optional; if present in token, validated against the application. A mismatch returns 404.
**ProgramID**: Optional; if present in token, validated against the application. A mismatch returns 404.
**BuyerID**: Optional; if present in token, validated against the application. A mismatch returns 404.

schema.description: Default error model for application errors

message.description: A simple message in english describing the error and can be returned to the consumer

domain.description: The domain where the error is originating from as defined by the service

metadata.description: Any additional details to be conveyed as determined by the service. If present, will return map of key value pairs

reason.description:
A machine-readable reason code identifying the specific error condition. Possible values and their meanings:

- `Application_Not_Found`: No Application exists for the provided ID within the caller's scope.
- `Short_Code_Not_Found`: No in-store short code exists matching the provided value.
- `Tenant_Not_Found`: The Tenant ID derived from the JWT could not be found.
- `Buyer_Not_Found`: The Buyer ID derived from the JWT or request could not be found.
- `Location_Not_Found`: The Location ID provided in the request extensions could not be found.
- `Merchant_Not_Found`: The Merchant ID derived from the JWT or request could not be found.
- `Payment_Agreement_Not_Found`: No Payment Agreement exists for the provided Agreement ID.
- `Offer_Not_Found`: No Offer exists for the provided Offer ID.
- `Start_Request_Validation`: One or more fields in the Start Application request failed validation. Check the `metadata` field for per-field details.
- `Checkout_Request_Validation`: One or more fields in the Checkout request failed validation. Check the `metadata` field for per-field details.
- `Prescreen_Request_Validation`: One or more fields in the Prescreen request failed validation.
- `Eligibility_Request_Validation`: One or more fields in the Eligibility request failed validation.
- `List_Request_Validation`: One or more query parameters in the List Applications request failed validation.
- `Request_Validation`: One or more fields in the request failed validation.
- `Invalid_Request_Body`: The request body could not be parsed as valid JSON.
- `Too_Many_Requests`: The request was rejected due to rate limiting. Retry after a short back-off period.
- `Missing_Required_IDs`: The JWT is missing required identity claims (e.g. tenantID).
- `Disclosure_Invalid`: One or more disclosures failed validation (e.g. invalid checksum or missing required type).
- `Invalid_Application_Status`: The Application is not in a status that permits the requested operation.
- `Invalid_Offer_Status`: The Offer is not in a status that permits the requested operation.
- `ApplicationExpired`: The Application has passed its expiration time and can no longer be used.
- `Short_Code_Expired`: The in-store short code associated with the Application has expired.
- `Application_Not_Expired`: A request was made that requires the Application to be expired, but it has not expired yet.
- `Down_Payment_Failure`: The down-payment payment method authorization failed during Checkout.

post.description:
Allows a Buyer to submit a selected Payment Agreement in order to complete a Transaction and check out with a Merchant.

Upon success, the updated Application details will be returned. Possible Application statuses include CANCELLED, NEEDS_ACTION, DENIED and CHECKOUT_COMPLETED. Any of these statuses will result in a 200 OK response - the client must check the status field in the response body.

An application with status NEEDS_ACTION and statusCode 070201 indicates that the payment method was declined and the Buyer is allowed to retry Checkout with a new paymentMethodID.

In the event that the BuyerHash Check fails when attempting to complete a checkout, the application will be marked with status CANCELLED and statusCode 010101.

Upon completed checkout, a Transaction record is generated for the Merchant and the Buyer's Checkout is now complete.

**JWT Claim Authorization:**
**TenantID**: Required (non-nil); set as the checkout request's `tenantID`.
**MerchantID**: Optional; if present in token, validated against the application during checkout.
**ProgramID**: Optional; if present in token, validated against the application during checkout.
**BuyerID**: Optional; if present in token, validated against the application during checkout.

schema.title: ApplicationError
schema.description: Default error model for application errors

message.description: A simple message in english describing the error and can be returned to the consumer

domain.description: The domain where the error is originating from as defined by the service

metadata.description: Any additional details to be conveyed as determined by the service. If present, will return map of key value pairs

reason.description:
A machine-readable reason code identifying the specific error condition. Possible values and their meanings:

- `Application_Not_Found`: No Application exists for the provided ID within the caller's scope.
- `Short_Code_Not_Found`: No in-store short code exists matching the provided value.
- `Tenant_Not_Found`: The Tenant ID derived from the JWT could not be found.
- `Buyer_Not_Found`: The Buyer ID derived from the JWT or request could not be found.
- `Location_Not_Found`: The Location ID provided in the request extensions could not be found.
- `Merchant_Not_Found`: The Merchant ID derived from the JWT or request could not be found.
- `Payment_Agreement_Not_Found`: No Payment Agreement exists for the provided Agreement ID.
- `Offer_Not_Found`: No Offer exists for the provided Offer ID.
- `Start_Request_Validation`: One or more fields in the Start Application request failed validation. Check the `metadata` field for per-field details.
- `Checkout_Request_Validation`: One or more fields in the Checkout request failed validation. Check the `metadata` field for per-field details.
- `Prescreen_Request_Validation`: One or more fields in the Prescreen request failed validation.
- `Eligibility_Request_Validation`: One or more fields in the Eligibility request failed validation.
- `List_Request_Validation`: One or more query parameters in the List Applications request failed validation.
- `Request_Validation`: One or more fields in the request failed validation.
- `Invalid_Request_Body`: The request body could not be parsed as valid JSON.
- `Too_Many_Requests`: The request was rejected due to rate limiting. Retry after a short back-off period.
- `Missing_Required_IDs`: The JWT is missing required identity claims (e.g. tenantID).
- `Disclosure_Invalid`: One or more disclosures failed validation (e.g. invalid checksum or missing required type).
- `Invalid_Application_Status`: The Application is not in a status that permits the requested operation.
- `Invalid_Offer_Status`: The Offer is not in a status that permits the requested operation.
- `ApplicationExpired`: The Application has passed its expiration time and can no longer be used.
- `Short_Code_Expired`: The in-store short code associated with the Application has expired.
- `Application_Not_Expired`: A request was made that requires the Application to be expired, but it has not expired yet.
- `Down_Payment_Failure`: The down-payment payment method authorization failed during Checkout.
- `Down_Payments_Not_Enabled`: Down payments are not enabled for this Program or Merchant-Program configuration.
- `Payment_Method_Not_Found`: No Payment Method exists for the provided Payment Method ID.
- `Failed_Transaction_Auth_Check`: The transaction authorization check against the buyer's account failed.
- `Purchase_Window_Closed`: The HyLOC purchase window has been closed; the transaction cannot be authorized.
- `Purchase_Window_Closed_Prior_To_Request`: The HyLOC purchase window was already closed before this request was received.
- `Expected_Purchase_Window_Close_Date_Not_Set`: The expected purchase-window close date was not set before a subsequent transaction authorization was attempted.
- `Invalid_Payment_Product`: The Payment Product associated with the Application is not valid for the requested operation.
- `Insufficient_Remaining_Capacity`: The transaction amount exceeds the Application's remaining capacity.
- `Invalid_Program_Checkout_Mode`: The Program's configured checkout mode does not match the type of checkout being attempted.
- `Merchant_Is_Not_Bopis_Enabled`: The Merchant is not configured for Buy Online, Pickup In-Store (BOPIS) checkout.
- `Resource_Forbidden`: The JWT does not have sufficient privileges to perform this action on the requested resource.
- `Dependency_Response_Invalid`: A required downstream service returned a response that could not be processed.
- `Dependency_Response_Error`: A required downstream service returned an unrecoverable error.
- `Dependency_Unavailable`: A required downstream service did not respond or is unavailable.
- `Service_Unavailable`: The Application service is temporarily unable to process the request.

post.description:
Allows a Buyer to submit offers/terms for an Application to prepare a checkout in a Merchant store.

This runs BOF for use by the Checkout Experience, without completing application checkout.

A short code will be generated and linked to the created application and selected offer.

 Application status will be updated to ATTEMPTED_PREPARE_CHECKOUT, and finally CHECKOUT_PREPARED after actual application checkout.

In the event that the BuyerHash Check fails when attempting to prepare a checkout, the application will be marked with status CANCELLED and statusCode 010101.

**JWT Claim Authorization:**
**TenantID**: Required (non-nil); set as the prepare request's `tenantID`.
**MerchantID**: Optional; if present in token, included in the prepare request.
**ProgramID**: Optional; if present in token, included in the prepare request.
**BuyerID**: Optional; if present in token, included in the prepare request.

schema.title: ApplicationError
schema.description: Default error model for application errors

message.description: A simple message in english describing the error and can be returned to the consumer

domain.description: The domain where the error is originating from as defined by the service

metadata.description: Any additional details to be conveyed as determined by the service. If present, will return map of key value pairs

reason.description:
A machine-readable reason code identifying the specific error condition. Possible values and their meanings:

- `Application_Not_Found`: No Application exists for the provided ID within the caller's scope.
- `Short_Code_Not_Found`: No in-store short code exists matching the provided value.
- `Tenant_Not_Found`: The Tenant ID derived from the JWT could not be found.
- `Buyer_Not_Found`: The Buyer ID derived from the JWT or request could not be found.
- `Location_Not_Found`: The Location ID provided in the request extensions could not be found.
- `Merchant_Not_Found`: The Merchant ID derived from the JWT or request could not be found.
- `Payment_Agreement_Not_Found`: No Payment Agreement exists for the provided Agreement ID.
- `Offer_Not_Found`: No Offer exists for the provided Offer ID.
- `Start_Request_Validation`: One or more fields in the Start Application request failed validation. Check the `metadata` field for per-field details.
- `Checkout_Request_Validation`: One or more fields in the Checkout request failed validation. Check the `metadata` field for per-field details.
- `Prescreen_Request_Validation`: One or more fields in the Prescreen request failed validation.
- `Eligibility_Request_Validation`: One or more fields in the Eligibility request failed validation.
- `List_Request_Validation`: One or more query parameters in the List Applications request failed validation.
- `Request_Validation`: One or more fields in the request failed validation.
- `Invalid_Request_Body`: The request body could not be parsed as valid JSON.
- `Too_Many_Requests`: The request was rejected due to rate limiting. Retry after a short back-off period.
- `Missing_Required_IDs`: The JWT is missing required identity claims (e.g. tenantID).
- `Disclosure_Invalid`: One or more disclosures failed validation (e.g. invalid checksum or missing required type).
- `Invalid_Application_Status`: The Application is not in a status that permits the requested operation.
- `Invalid_Offer_Status`: The Offer is not in a status that permits the requested operation.
- `ApplicationExpired`: The Application has passed its expiration time and can no longer be used.
- `Short_Code_Expired`: The in-store short code associated with the Application has expired.
- `Application_Not_Expired`: A request was made that requires the Application to be expired, but it has not expired yet.
- `Down_Payment_Failure`: The down-payment payment method authorization failed during Checkout.
- `Down_Payments_Not_Enabled`: Down payments are not enabled for this Program or Merchant-Program configuration.
- `Payment_Method_Not_Found`: No Payment Method exists for the provided Payment Method ID.
- `Failed_Transaction_Auth_Check`: The transaction authorization check against the buyer's account failed.
- `Purchase_Window_Closed`: The HyLOC purchase window has been closed; the transaction cannot be authorized.
- `Purchase_Window_Closed_Prior_To_Request`: The HyLOC purchase window was already closed before this request was received.
- `Expected_Purchase_Window_Close_Date_Not_Set`: The expected purchase-window close date was not set before a subsequent transaction authorization was attempted.
- `Invalid_Payment_Product`: The Payment Product associated with the Application is not valid for the requested operation.
- `Insufficient_Remaining_Capacity`: The transaction amount exceeds the Application's remaining capacity.
- `Invalid_Program_Checkout_Mode`: The Program's configured checkout mode does not match the type of checkout being attempted.
- `Merchant_Is_Not_Bopis_Enabled`: The Merchant is not configured for Buy Online, Pickup In-Store (BOPIS) checkout.
- `Resource_Forbidden`: The JWT does not have sufficient privileges to perform this action on the requested resource.
- `Dependency_Response_Invalid`: A required downstream service returned a response that could not be processed.
- `Dependency_Response_Error`: A required downstream service returned an unrecoverable error.
- `Dependency_Unavailable`: A required downstream service did not respond or is unavailable.
- `Service_Unavailable`: The Application service is temporarily unable to process the request.

post.description:
Allows a Buyer to submit a generated short code in order to complete a Transaction and checkout with a Merchant.

Upon success, the updated Application details will be returned. Possible Application statuses include CANCELLED and CHECKOUT_COMPLETED. Any of these statuses will result in a 200 OK response - the client must check the status field in the response body.

In the event that the BuyerHash Check fails when attempting to complete a checkout for an Instore Application, the application will be marked with status CANCELLED and statusCode 010101.

Upon completed checkout, a Transaction record is generated for the Merchant and the Buyer's Checkout is now complete.

**JWT Claim Authorization:**
**TenantID**: Required (non-nil); set as the application's `tenantID`.
**MerchantID**: Required (non-nil); must be present in the token for this request to proceed.
**ProgramID**: Required (non-nil); must be present in the token for this request to proceed.
**BuyerID**: Optional; set as the application's `buyerID` if present.

schema.title: ApplicationError
schema.description: Default error model for application errors

message.description: A simple message in english describing the error and can be returned to the consumer

domain.description: The domain where the error is originating from as defined by the service

metadata.description: Any additional details to be conveyed as determined by the service. If present, will return map of key value pairs

reason.description:
A machine-readable reason code identifying the specific error condition. Possible values and their meanings:

- `Application_Not_Found`: No Application exists for the provided ID within the caller's scope.
- `Short_Code_Not_Found`: No in-store short code exists matching the provided value.
- `Tenant_Not_Found`: The Tenant ID derived from the JWT could not be found.
- `Buyer_Not_Found`: The Buyer ID derived from the JWT or request could not be found.
- `Location_Not_Found`: The Location ID provided in the request extensions could not be found.
- `Merchant_Not_Found`: The Merchant ID derived from the JWT or request could not be found.
- `Payment_Agreement_Not_Found`: No Payment Agreement exists for the provided Agreement ID.
- `Offer_Not_Found`: No Offer exists for the provided Offer ID.
- `Start_Request_Validation`: One or more fields in the Start Application request failed validation. Check the `metadata` field for per-field details.
- `Checkout_Request_Validation`: One or more fields in the Checkout request failed validation. Check the `metadata` field for per-field details.
- `Prescreen_Request_Validation`: One or more fields in the Prescreen request failed validation.
- `Eligibility_Request_Validation`: One or more fields in the Eligibility request failed validation.
- `List_Request_Validation`: One or more query parameters in the List Applications request failed validation.
- `Request_Validation`: One or more fields in the request failed validation.
- `Invalid_Request_Body`: The request body could not be parsed as valid JSON.
- `Too_Many_Requests`: The request was rejected due to rate limiting. Retry after a short back-off period.
- `Missing_Required_IDs`: The JWT is missing required identity claims (e.g. tenantID).
- `Disclosure_Invalid`: One or more disclosures failed validation (e.g. invalid checksum or missing required type).
- `Invalid_Application_Status`: The Application is not in a status that permits the requested operation.
- `Invalid_Offer_Status`: The Offer is not in a status that permits the requested operation.
- `ApplicationExpired`: The Application has passed its expiration time and can no longer be used.
- `Short_Code_Expired`: The in-store short code associated with the Application has expired.
- `Application_Not_Expired`: A request was made that requires the Application to be expired, but it has not expired yet.
- `Down_Payment_Failure`: The down-payment payment method authorization failed during Checkout.
- `Down_Payments_Not_Enabled`: Down payments are not enabled for this Program or Merchant-Program configuration.
- `Payment_Method_Not_Found`: No Payment Method exists for the provided Payment Method ID.
- `Failed_Transaction_Auth_Check`: The transaction authorization check against the buyer's account failed.
- `Purchase_Window_Closed`: The HyLOC purchase window has been closed; the transaction cannot be authorized.
- `Purchase_Window_Closed_Prior_To_Request`: The HyLOC purchase window was already closed before this request was received.
- `Expected_Purchase_Window_Close_Date_Not_Set`: The expected purchase-window close date was not set before a subsequent transaction authorization was attempted.
- `Invalid_Payment_Product`: The Payment Product associated with the Application is not valid for the requested operation.
- `Insufficient_Remaining_Capacity`: The transaction amount exceeds the Application's remaining capacity.
- `Invalid_Program_Checkout_Mode`: The Program's configured checkout mode does not match the type of checkout being attempted.
- `Merchant_Is_Not_Bopis_Enabled`: The Merchant is not configured for Buy Online, Pickup In-Store (BOPIS) checkout.
- `Resource_Forbidden`: The JWT does not have sufficient privileges to perform this action on the requested resource.
- `Dependency_Response_Invalid`: A required downstream service returned a response that could not be processed.
- `Dependency_Response_Error`: A required downstream service returned an unrecoverable error.
- `Dependency_Unavailable`: A required downstream service did not respond or is unavailable.
- `Service_Unavailable`: The Application service is temporarily unable to process the request.

- `Insufficient_Remaining_Capacity`: The transaction amount exceeds the Application's remaining capacity.
- `Invalid_Program_Checkout_Mode`: The Program's configured checkout mode does not match the type of checkout being attempted.
- `Merchant_Is_Not_Bopis_Enabled`: The Merchant is not configured for Buy Online, Pickup In-Store (BOPIS) checkout.
- `Resource_Forbidden`: The JWT does not have sufficient privileges to perform this action on the requested resource.
- `Dependency_Response_Invalid`: A required downstream service returned a response that could not be processed.
- `Dependency_Response_Error`: A required downstream service returned an unrecoverable error.
- `Dependency_Unavailable`: A required downstream service did not respond or is unavailable.
- `Service_Unavailable`: The Application service is temporarily unable to process the request.

ApplicationError.description: Default error model for application errors

message.description: A simple message in english describing the error and can be returned to the consumer

domain.description: The domain where the error is originating from as defined by the service

metadata.description: Any additional details to be conveyed as determined by the service. If present, will return map of key value pairs

reason.description:
A machine-readable reason code identifying the specific error condition. Possible values and their meanings:

- `Application_Not_Found`: No Application exists for the provided ID within the caller's scope.
- `Short_Code_Not_Found`: No in-store short code exists matching the provided value.
- `Tenant_Not_Found`: The Tenant ID derived from the JWT could not be found.
- `Buyer_Not_Found`: The Buyer ID derived from the JWT or request could not be found.
- `Location_Not_Found`: The Location ID provided in the request extensions could not be found.
- `Merchant_Not_Found`: The Merchant ID derived from the JWT or request could not be found.
- `Payment_Agreement_Not_Found`: No Payment Agreement exists for the provided Agreement ID.
- `Offer_Not_Found`: No Offer exists for the provided Offer ID.
- `Start_Request_Validation`: One or more fields in the Start Application request failed validation. Check the `metadata` field for per-field details.
- `Checkout_Request_Validation`: One or more fields in the Checkout request failed validation. Check the `metadata` field for per-field details.
- `Prescreen_Request_Validation`: One or more fields in the Prescreen request failed validation.
- `Eligibility_Request_Validation`: One or more fields in the Eligibility request failed validation.
- `List_Request_Validation`: One or more query parameters in the List Applications request failed validation.
- `Request_Validation`: One or more fields in the request failed validation.
- `Invalid_Request_Body`: The request body could not be parsed as valid JSON.
- `Too_Many_Requests`: The request was rejected due to rate limiting. Retry after a short back-off period.
- `Missing_Required_IDs`: The JWT is missing required identity claims (e.g. tenantID).
- `Disclosure_Invalid`: One or more disclosures failed validation (e.g. invalid checksum or missing required type).
- `Invalid_Application_Status`: The Application is not in a status that permits the requested operation.
- `Invalid_Offer_Status`: The Offer is not in a status that permits the requested operation.
- `ApplicationExpired`: The Application has passed its expiration time and can no longer be used.
- `Short_Code_Expired`: The in-store short code associated with the Application has expired.
- `Application_Not_Expired`: A request was made that requires the Application to be expired, but it has not expired yet.
- `Down_Payment_Failure`: The down-payment payment method authorization failed during Checkout.
- `Down_Payments_Not_Enabled`: Down payments are not enabled for this Program or Merchant-Program configuration.
- `Payment_Method_Not_Found`: No Payment Method exists for the provided Payment Method ID.
- `Failed_Transaction_Auth_Check`: The transaction authorization check against the buyer's account failed.
- `Purchase_Window_Closed`: The HyLOC purchase window has been closed; the transaction cannot be authorized.
- `Purchase_Window_Closed_Prior_To_Request`: The HyLOC purchase window was already closed before this request was received.
- `Expected_Purchase_Window_Close_Date_Not_Set`: The expected purchase-window close date was not set before a subsequent transaction authorization was attempted.
- `Invalid_Payment_Product`: The Payment Product associated with the Application is not valid for the requested operation.
- `Insufficient_Remaining_Capacity`: The transaction amount exceeds the Application's remaining capacity.
- `Invalid_Program_Checkout_Mode`: The Program's configured checkout mode does not match the type of checkout being attempted.
- `Merchant_Is_Not_Bopis_Enabled`: The Merchant is not configured for Buy Online, Pickup In-Store (BOPIS) checkout.
- `Resource_Forbidden`: The JWT does not have sufficient privileges to perform this action on the requested resource.
- `Dependency_Response_Invalid`: A required downstream service returned a response that could not be processed.
- `Dependency_Response_Error`: A required downstream service returned an unrecoverable error.
- `Dependency_Unavailable`: A required downstream service did not respond or is unavailable.
- `Service_Unavailable`: The Application service is temporarily unable to process the request.

schema.title: ApplicationError
schema.description: Default error model for application errors

message.description: A simple message in english describing the error and can be returned to the consumer

domain.description: The domain where the error is originating from as defined by the service

metadata.description: Any additional details to be conveyed as determined by the service. If present, will return map of key value pairs

reason.description:
A machine-readable reason code identifying the specific error condition. Possible values and their meanings:

- `Application_Not_Found`: No Application exists for the provided ID within the caller's scope.
- `Short_Code_Not_Found`: No in-store short code exists matching the provided value.
- `Tenant_Not_Found`: The Tenant ID derived from the JWT could not be found.
- `Buyer_Not_Found`: The Buyer ID derived from the JWT or request could not be found.
- `Location_Not_Found`: The Location ID provided in the request extensions could not be found.
- `Merchant_Not_Found`: The Merchant ID derived from the JWT or request could not be found.
- `Payment_Agreement_Not_Found`: No Payment Agreement exists for the provided Agreement ID.
- `Offer_Not_Found`: No Offer exists for the provided Offer ID.
- `Start_Request_Validation`: One or more fields in the Start Application request failed validation. Check the `metadata` field for per-field details.
- `Checkout_Request_Validation`: One or more fields in the Checkout request failed validation. Check the `metadata` field for per-field details.
- `Prescreen_Request_Validation`: One or more fields in the Prescreen request failed validation.
- `Eligibility_Request_Validation`: One or more fields in the Eligibility request failed validation.
- `List_Request_Validation`: One or more query parameters in the List Applications request failed validation.
- `Request_Validation`: One or more fields in the request failed validation.
- `Invalid_Request_Body`: The request body could not be parsed as valid JSON.
- `Too_Many_Requests`: The request was rejected due to rate limiting. Retry after a short back-off period.
- `Missing_Required_IDs`: The JWT is missing required identity claims (e.g. tenantID).
- `Disclosure_Invalid`: One or more disclosures failed validation (e.g. invalid checksum or missing required type).
- `Invalid_Application_Status`: The Application is not in a status that permits the requested operation.
- `Invalid_Offer_Status`: The Offer is not in a status that permits the requested operation.
- `ApplicationExpired`: The Application has passed its expiration time and can no longer be used.
- `Short_Code_Expired`: The in-store short code associated with the Application has expired.
- `Application_Not_Expired`: A request was made that requires the Application to be expired, but it has not expired yet.
- `Down_Payment_Failure`: The down-payment payment method authorization failed during Checkout.
- `Down_Payments_Not_Enabled`: Down payments are not enabled for this Program or Merchant-Program configuration.
- `Payment_Method_Not_Found`: No Payment Method exists for the provided Payment Method ID.
- `Failed_Transaction_Auth_Check`: The transaction authorization check against the buyer's account failed.
- `Purchase_Window_Closed`: The HyLOC purchase window has been closed; the transaction cannot be authorized.
- `Purchase_Window_Closed_Prior_To_Request`: The HyLOC purchase window was already closed before this request was received.
- `Expected_Purchase_Window_Close_Date_Not_Set`: The expected purchase-window close date was not set before a subsequent transaction authorization was attempted.
- `Invalid_Payment_Product`: The Payment Product associated with the Application is not valid for the requested operation.
- `Insufficient_Remaining_Capacity`: The transaction amount exceeds the Application's remaining capacity.
- `Invalid_Program_Checkout_Mode`: The Program's configured checkout mode does not match the type of checkout being attempted.
- `Merchant_Is_Not_Bopis_Enabled`: The Merchant is not configured for Buy Online, Pickup In-Store (BOPIS) checkout.
- `Resource_Forbidden`: The JWT does not have sufficient privileges to perform this action on the requested resource.
- `Dependency_Response_Invalid`: A required downstream service returned a response that could not be processed.
- `Dependency_Response_Error`: A required downstream service returned an unrecoverable error.
- `Dependency_Unavailable`: A required downstream service did not respond or is unavailable.
- `Service_Unavailable`: The Application service is temporarily unable to process the request.
